claim: Combine Market direction and leadership concentration should matter more than broad diversification. WITH Recent 12-week acceleration can identify leadership before it appears in slower 52-week ranks.
causal_mechanism: Leadership baskets can compound when market regime supports risk-on participation. Combined with: Momentum underreaction may first appear in intermediate returns before full-year rankings update.
expected_effect: Improve 24/52 week stability versus SPY and parent while avoiding duplicate artifacts.
falsification_rule: Reject if selected universe, trades, or artifacts duplicate parent, or if monthly/yearly SPY comparison does not improve.
